title: Deep Core Prospecting from Sol Central: 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter, deep core mining XP; 20 platinum ore mined at Markab Belt (3 jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:13 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6; rules F34, F37). Foreman Voss offers Deep Core Prospecting (mine 20 platinum ore, 5,000 cr and 10 exotic matter) on the board of Confederacy Central Command (table missions, read 23:01 UTC); our Nova Terra copy of it paid 3,500 cr a ship-hour over 10 runs on 2026-11-17 and is once per pilot (mission-deep-core-prospecting-nova-terra). Markab Belt (Solarian, policed, 3 jumps by Sirius and Epsilon Eridani) reads 198 platinum of 8,000, richness 18 (census 4.6 h old); min_left 40 keeps a floor, so about 7 pilots take it: max_pilots 7. For the Solarian-born miners' rows only: a Voidborn pilot has its own copies nearer home. The first stop stores the starter cargo. 2026-11-22 23:21 UTC (Zero): its first runs (23:15 to 23:19 UTC, 2 at Sol Central, 16 at the Grand Exchange) read `deep_core_prospecting not offered` to newborn pilots of Mining 0 (table runs); our Voidborn pilots that took it held Mining near 10. The board's own gate is not read: requires.skills mining 3 is a guess that closes it to the newborns until they have mined, to be read again on the first pilot that reaches it.
